items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I've been playing with Tony for a half and half years... Jeff had the band. Jeff Riddick. Hen Ring would play, and Ring was boyfriend, and then had Tony, Fuzzer Law playing, and then had Tony.

ctx.x: That's right. You know Tony, yeah, sure. You know, like Jack Riddick called Fuser-Loyal. Fuser-Loyal. Or Tony Fugero-Close. Yeah. Yeah, man. I played with Jeff and I played with Johnny Riddick, man. Where did you play with Johnny? Where? Where? Was he here in the city? In Mobile. Oh, you went over to Mobile? It's a spot job, you know. Oh, yeah? I played with Harry Torres, you know. I played so many bands, you know. And that's the expanded. One of us more. Who's that same? Did you hear that thing? No. I had Sam…
I'm doing a lot of stuff. I'm doing a lot of stuff.

items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: We had, I played, we played with, you know, we had a pretty nice little band. Not we, Jeff had the band. Jeff Riddick. Hen Ring would play, and Ring was boyfriend, and then had Tony, Fuzzer Law playing

ctx.x: How long have you been playing with Fuzzer?

How? Oh, God. I don't know Tony. I lost track. How long I don't know Tony. You mean how long I don't know Tony? Yeah. About 1970. I don't know Tony. About 1927. Did you play with him when you first met him? Yeah. Definitely. I've been playing with Tony for a half and half years, you know? We got on the house, you know? He called me a long ago. Right here. I was sleeping. And I talked, see? He called me. I want to talk to Sarah, you know? Mm-hmm. She said that he's sleeping. He said, well, it's more important to…
What about the Fern? What kind of numbers did you play at the Fern?
